verdict.rationale: Cursor's docs claim strong support for the full loop — tracing repos, planning, reproducing/fixing bugs, reviewing diffs, and integrating with GitHub/Linear/Slack via background and parallel agents (cursor-docs-2,3,4,6,8,9,10,11,12) — which together map onto an issue-to-PR workflow. However, all evidence is vendor-claimed documentation with no community or hands-on validation confirming this specific end-to-end flow works reliably, and available community feedback focuses on unrelated bugs/complaints rather than this capability.
